notes.title: Episode 2 is now available as a free update
notes.notes:
If you update your game and then run it, you should be presented with an option to replay Episode 1 or go straight to Episode 2. I read all of the user reviews and I greatly appreciate the feedback on Episode 1. I would love to hear additional feedback on Episode 2. 

While not all of the artwork for Episode 2 is brand new, there are several new scenes which use a more dynamic style more commonly found in visual novels. 

Episode 2 continues the story of Detective Harvey Jenkins, as he takes on another case in the Big Easy. Several characters from Episode 1 make an appearance and you start learning a little more about Harvey and what makes him different.

notes.title: Quick patch to fix download issue
notes.notes:
The package was pointing to the wrong depot and this caused the game to show as "Installed" and ready to "Play" before it downloaded anything. Please Delete Local Content and re-install to pick up the files. The total file download should be 196 MB.

Sorry for the inconvenience.
